stdout:
Usage: papyrus task edit [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>  

Options:
      --json
          Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --title <TITLE>
          
  -d, --description <DESCRIPTION>
          Use "-" to read multiline text from standard input.
      --dir <path>
          Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --ac <AC>
          
      --config <file>
          Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --comment <COMMENT>
          
      --no-color
          Disable ANSI color output.
      --comment-author <COMMENT_AUTHOR>
          
      --status <STATUS>
          
      --depends-on <DEPENDS_ON>
          
      --milestone <MILESTONE>
          
      --no-milestone [<NO_MILESTONE>]
          
      --label <LABEL>
          
      --reference <REFERENCE>
          
      --documentation <DOCUMENTATION>
          
      --type <TYPE>
          
      --ordinal <ORDINAL>
          
      --assignee <ASSIGNEE>...
          
      --editor
          
  -h, --help
          Print help
